title: bdlg.collation/1 collation
description: The collation of a backfill run (Phase B): every ref of an evidence corpus resolved (B1 indexes, B2 resolution) against a baseline BeadLog and a ledger directory. One canonical-JSON line. units are the B3 work units (candidate beads, attachments to existing local beads, area epics), sorted by key; verdicts and residual are the B5 identification against the baseline; conflicts is filled by B6 and is an empty array until then. Implemented by beadlog_sources.collate.

verdicts.description: B5: one record per identify step that answered for a unit, sorted by unit then step; a unit's decision is its record with a non-null class.

conflicts.description: B6: status conflicts, sorted by unit, rule and artifacts; none is ever resolved.

residual.description: B5: one record per unit no identify step decided, sorted by unit.

attachments.description: B4: one record per design record, sorted by doc.

lifecycle.description: B6: one record per unit, sorted by unit.

options.description: The effective options of the collate steps that ran, one sub-object per step (later steps add siblings): a collation made under other options has other bytes.

new_threshold.description: Percent: a unit nothing else decided whose fuzzy score is below it is NEW (inferred); null turns the threshold step off.

max_candidates.description: Baseline beads (and, separately, epics) offered by the match query.

identify_verdict.description: One B5 verdict: the answer of one identify step for one unit.

class.description: The identification; null for a judge abstention (the unit goes on to the threshold or the residual).

bead.description: The matched baseline bead (PRESENT) or covering epic (NOISE).

provenance.description: derived for bridges and the lexical engine; inferred for the judge and the threshold.

score.description: Fuzzy score in percent: the best title-token Jaccard against the baseline (null for bridges).

family.description: Judgment family of the query (collate.identify), null without a query.

query_hash.description: Identity of the match query; a judge verdict is reused by it on resume.

outcome.description: The chosen option key (present:N, noise:N, new; the bead id for a bridge), null to abstain.

fallback.description: Why the configured engine did not answer (timeout, exit, malformed, ...).

identify_residual.description: One B5 residual record: a unit left for a human (or for the next run).

reason.description: judge-budget: the call cap stopped the run before this unit; the next run continues.

candidates.description: The baseline bead ids the match query offered, best first.

rules.description: The claim rules run, in order.

include_types.description: cc_type values the commit rule makes units of; * matches any.

epics.description: Whether the area rule grouped units into area epics.

areas.description: Override map: a key with / is a path prefix, any other key renames a derived area.

tiers.description: The attach tiers run, in order.

lexical_percent.description: Minimum overlap coefficient (percent) of the lexical tier.

standalone.description: Whether an unattached doc became a doc-unit.

design_only.description: Normalized phrases that make a raw declared status design only.

doc_default.description: Status of a unit with no evidential closure; absent in a record written before 0.37 (read back as closed).

doc_open.description: Declared doc statuses that keep a unit open under from-doc.

moment.description: A point in time with its precision: a canonical timestamp (second) or YYYY-MM-DD (day, never read as midnight), and the artifact or unit whose clock gave it.

lifecycle.description: B6: a unit's status and dates, derived from history only.

closed.description: Null unless the unit is closed.

conflict_source.description: One side of a conflict: the artifact claims value (normalized; raw as written) for field.

at.description: The moment compared, for the date rules.

conflict.description: B6: two artifacts that disagree about a unit. status is the unit's status as derived from history; a conflict never changes it.

sources.description: The claim, then the evidence against it.

attachment.description: One B4 record: design record doc belongs to unit. A doc has at most one attachment.

unit.description: Key of the unit it attaches to (the doc itself for standalone).

evidence.description: Artifact keys behind the decision (empty for standalone).

key.description: Stable source key, later the bead's external_ref: the anchor artifact's key (plan:<item>, gh:pr/<n>, git:commit/<sha>), bead:<id> for an attach unit, area:<name> for an area epic.

kind.description: epic has children; issue is a leaf candidate bead; attach is evidence for the existing local bead named by bead.

rule.description: The rule that formed the unit (B3 rules; doc is B4: a design record no unit took).

bead.description: The existing local bead id of an attach unit; null otherwise.

artifacts.description: Artifact keys the unit claimed (its evidence), anchor first. An artifact is claimed by at most one unit.

area.description: The area a grouped unit falls in.

parent.description: Key of the parent unit (area epic or parent plan item).

children.description: Keys of the child units, sorted.

depends_on.description: Keys of the units a plan item depends on, sorted.

source.description: Key of the artifact the ref was found in.

ledger.description: Owning ledger for local and foreign.

candidates.description: Competing ledgers (ambiguous) or the foreign shadow of a local hit.

targets.description: Artifact keys for artifact, or the competing artifacts of an ambiguous sha.
